revision: 2026-09-13 core-extraction correction. Earlier revisions read the same-spacing cardinal comparator from the anchor row N//2 of the finite clamped matrix. For N at most 4p-2 that row lies within 2p of the far wall, so its band mixes non-cardinal basis functions and the comparator was not the cardinal Toeplitz section of the theorem. Every core is now read from the central row of a reference matrix of size 4p+9, where the anchor row and its whole band are translation-invariant. Every reference size at or above 4p+3 yields the identical cardinal band, 8p+9 included, so the reference size is a cost choice. The corrected small-N controls replace the superseded values bmg_pencil=8p-8 and bmf_pencil=8p-9 at N=4p-2; results for N at least 4p-1 are unchanged.
